[[Lost Contact]] |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =Yes }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Thanks for your assistance with the vans. We were just in time, even those Scavs didn't have time to pull them apart. While researching the aftermath of the tunnel collapse, we’ve run across a TerraGroup executive's Geländewagen. It appears that part of the company’s top managers perished there while trying to evacuate. I’m aware that medical research was one of the top priorities for the company, and I'm almost sure that they had no time to evacuate its data and materials in time. Whatever they were doing, I think it can turn out to be very valuable, both for us and for medical science in general. It can earn us a ticket from Tarkov, even more than one. I’ve regularly met up with certain TerraGroup employees to discuss health care issues, so I'm pretty familiar with some of their works. One of my acquaintances, who, by the way, directly reported to that deceased Geländewagen management, used to live in the health resort building. Let me look it up... here it is, room 306. Search it for anything that could possibly be left behind.}} ==Objectives== * Search the [[Health Resort west wing room 306 key|room]] in the Health Resort for any [[Secure Folder 0060|documents]] about TerraGroup's research on [[Shoreline]] * Hand over the retrieved [[Secure Folder 0060|information]] * Survive and extract from the location ==Rewards== * +5,900 [[EXP]] * [[Therapist]] Rep '''+0.04''' * 24,000 Roubles ** 25,200 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1 ** 27,600 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2 * 4× [[Salewa first aid kit]] {{quote|Do you have the documents?
